channel.title: Counterwise
channel.description: Kitchen gear, judged on the trade-offs. Specification comparisons for air fryers and meat thermometers, with sources and open questions published.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two machines, one word on the box. The differences that decide whether it fits your cooking are almost never the ones printed on the front.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts are a volume. Dinner is an area problem. Here is the twenty-minute check that stops a wrong purchase.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs that show up every single day, and the two that show up once at the till.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: A multi-function machine is a promise that one box replaces three. Here is how to check whether that promise holds for your kitchen.

item.title: Instant-read or wireless probe: which thermometer do you need?
item.description: One is a checking tool. The other is a monitoring tool. Buying the wrong one is the most common thermometer mistake.

item.title: CHEFMAN 6 Qt Dual Basket — specifications and trade-offs
item.description: Two independent 3-quart baskets, so a protein and a side can finish on different clocks.

item.title: Emeril Lagasse 26 Qt French Door — specifications and trade-offs
item.description: A 26-quart French-door oven with 24 presets and six accessories included, for cooks who want one box to do more than fry.

item.title: CHEFMAN 8 Qt TurboFry — specifications and trade-offs
item.description: One 8-quart basket with a 450°F top range — the largest single-basket capacity in this set.

item.title: ThermoMaven 1 Sec Thermometer — specifications and trade-offs
item.description: A fold-out instant-read probe rated IP67, which matters more than a decimal place of accuracy for most home cooks.

item.title: CHEF iQ Sense Gen3 — specifications and trade-offs
item.description: Three wireless probes and five sensors, for anyone monitoring more than one piece of meat at a time.
